pages.title: About Universe
pages.description: Universe is the operating system for modern schools — academics, attendance, results, finance, and family messaging.

sections.heading: One platform for every institution.
sections.subheading: Universe brings nursery, primary, secondary, and tertiary schools onto a single operating system — so admins, teachers, parents, and learners share the same source of truth.

sections.heading: Built for schools that outgrew spreadsheets.
sections.body:
Most schools run on a patchwork of attendance books, fee ledgers, WhatsApp groups, and report-card templates. Universe replaces that pile with guided setup, role-aware dashboards, and engines that work the same way from nursery through tertiary.

We start with Nursery & Primary — clear onboarding, admin email verification, and the core engines schools need on day one — then scale into secondary and tertiary workflows without re-platforming.

pages.title: Privacy — Universe
pages.description: How Universe handles school and personal data.

sections.heading: Your school’s data stays yours.
sections.subheading: We process institution and user data to operate the platform — scoped by tenant, with role-aware access.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Universe collects account details, institutional configuration, and operational records required to run attendance, assessment, results, finance, and messaging.

We do not sell student or parent data. Access is limited by institution and role. Platform operators only see what is required for support and platform administration.

Contact hello@universe.school for privacy requests.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Universe provides software for school operations. Institutions remain responsible for the accuracy of academic and financial records entered by their users.

Accounts must be used only by authorised staff, parents, and learners. Abuse, cross-tenant access attempts, or misuse of learner data is prohibited.

Contact hello@universe.school for commercial terms and agreements.

faqs.question: How do I create a school?
faqs.answer: From the marketing site or portal, choose Create school. Pick your institution type, enter name and slug, then create the first admin account and verify email.

faqs.question: Can existing staff sign in?
faqs.answer: Yes. Staff invited to your institution sign in with email and password on the portal — scoped to your school tenant.

faqs.question: What engines are included?
faqs.answer: Attendance, Assessment, Result, and Finance engines share the same academic structure and roles.

faqs.question: Does Universe support secondary and tertiary?
faqs.answer: Yes. The product is designed for every institution tier; Nursery & Primary is the first polished onboarding path.

faqs.question: Is my school’s data isolated?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tenants are institution-scoped — including notifications, dashboards, and messaging fan-out.
